requirements.title: IMPORT has a basic optional-list form and distinct ONLY, NONE and ALL forms
requirements.definition: IMPORT may stand alone or have a nonempty import-name list optionally preceded by ::. The other alternatives are IMPORT, ONLY: followed by a required list, IMPORT, NONE, and IMPORT, ALL. The basic optional separator is inside the optional list group; IMPORT:: alone is not the listless form. R401 and assumed R402/R603 govern lists and names. No rename, selector, generic-spec or declaration suffix is part of import-name.

pending.bare-form: PENDING a complete module with a prior ordinary INTEGER host entity and a contained module subroutine beginning with bare IMPORT before IMPLICIT NONE and local declarations. No conflicting names or second IMPORT is needed. This is compile admission, not a scope-wide runtime proof.
pending.basic-list-no-colon: PENDING the same complete host/contained-procedure context with IMPORT host_item, a real host name. Preserve prior host declaration and avoid creating a local declaration that violates C8106.
pending.basic-list-double-colon: PENDING the same context with IMPORT :: host_item. Only the optional separator changes; the imported entity and scope remain fixed.
pending.basic-multiple-names: PENDING two distinct prior-declared host entities in IMPORT :: first, second, with no local homonyms. R401 supplies the nonempty comma list. Duplicate-list-name semantics are not guessed or required for this initial control.
pending.only-required-list: PENDING a complete contained procedure with IMPORT, ONLY: first, second. The comma and single colon belong to this alternative, and at least one import-name is required. This syntax control does not by itself prove exclusion of unlisted host names.
pending.none-form: PENDING IMPORT, NONE in a genuine contained procedure or ordinary interface body, not a submodule or forbidden top-level scope. Local declarations and actual interfaces remain complete. No host value is read.
pending.all-form: PENDING IMPORT, ALL in a contained procedure with no declaration, formal or USE name that would hide an imported host entity. There is only one IMPORT. The control is not an invocation or a no-shadow diagnostic.
pending.empty-list-and-separator-exclusions: PENDING separate complete IMPORT :: and IMPORT, ONLY: negatives, each repaired by inserting the already accessible host_item name, with all scope/order conditions fixed. A bare IMPORT repair is legitimate only for the first form and must not be conflated with an empty ONLY list. Qualify the actual missing-list cause rather than EOF, missing END or unsupported IMPORT.
pending.modifier-punctuation: PENDING isolated missing-comma or incorrect-colon spellings of ONLY, NONE and ALL with one-token repairs to a valid alternative. Keep semantic cardinality, host names, body scope and ordering valid; no broad parser-recovery predicate or a guessed combination of multiple specifiers.
pending.name-not-designator-or-rename: PENDING a complete ordinary host array or derived object and IMPORT a(1) or IMPORT box%field, each separately repaired to the host's whole name. IMPORT does not offer local=>host renaming or OPERATOR(...) generic syntax. A host entity already renamed by USE is imported by its actual local host name; that is a different mechanism.
pending.scope-and-order-source: PENDING exact R504/R1109, C8100-C8106 and name-owner relationships. IMPORT follows USE and precedes the implicit/declaration part. The complete502-head scan finds no explicit import-name rule, so assumed R402 applies. Derived-type default host access does not authorize inserting IMPORT into R726, whose grammar has no such statement slot.

requirements.oracle: Complete legal host/scoping contexts and source-minimal grammar repairs, with exact list and modifier alternatives independently derived from the original production. Compile admissions, semantic scope effects and diagnostic causes remain separate.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Required numbered reporting is not mandatory fatal status, fixed English or printed R870. Wrong host role, ordering, C8102/C8104 combinations, C8106 hiding, missing providers, unsupported syntax, source echoes and native failures are not a different grammar predicate. No fixture or scope-use graph is supplied.

requirements.title: IMPORT is excluded from four top-level scoping-unit categories
requirements.definition: An IMPORT statement does not appear in the scoping unit of a main program, external subprogram, module or block data program unit. The restriction names the actual scoping unit, excluding nested scopes; it is not a ban everywhere in a file or module. Other syntax and constraints still govern allowed nested and submodule contexts.

pending.main-program-exclusion: PENDING a complete main program whose sole selected defect is a bare IMPORT before IMPLICIT NONE, repaired only by deleting IMPORT. No name list is used, avoiding a missing-host C8101 confound.
pending.external-subprogram-exclusion: PENDING complete external subroutine and explicitly typed function contexts with bare IMPORT before any IMPLICIT/declarations, repaired by deleting the statement. Do not accidentally make them internal/module procedures or use an undefined result runtime.
pending.module-exclusion: PENDING bare IMPORT in a complete module's own specification part, not inside a contained procedure or interface body. Delete only the IMPORT. The module has no missing dependencies or declarations.
pending.block-data-exclusion: PENDING a complete BLOCK DATA program unit with bare IMPORT as the selected scope defect, repaired only by deletion. Any COMMON initialization variant retains separate declarations, obsolescence and initialization rules; a missing linker main is not the diagnostic cause.
pending.nested-scope-controls: PENDING complete internal/module subprograms, ordinary and module-procedure interface bodies, BLOCK constructs and genuine submodule controls. Their containing program unit may be one of the excluded categories without making its nested scoping unit excluded. Use non-NONE submodule forms and C1412-complete ancestors.
pending.grammar-admission-not-sufficient-source: PENDING finite scope/grammar mapping through3.120,5.1,5.3.2,11.1.4,14.2.3 and15.4.3.2. Absence from C8100's list is not universal syntactic permission: a derived-type definition's default host association does not insert IMPORT into its R726 grammar.

requirements.oracle: Complete scope-category controls and one-statement deletion repairs with no name-list, provider or ordering defect. Preserve exact inclusive/nested scoping distinctions.
requirements.oracle_limitation: A report claiming IMPORT is universally interface-body-only is not adopted as the language definition. The finite malformed scopes and conforming nested controls need independent cause/mode evidence; unsupported permitted contexts cannot be recast as this constraint.

requirements.title: Each import-name denotes an entity in the host scoping unit
requirements.definition: Every listed import-name is the name of an entity in the host scoping unit. A name in some other module, a missing entity, or only a new declaration inside the importing scope does not by itself meet this condition. The host's actual accessible name and the imported entity's identity matter; IMPORT does not rename or create that host entity.

pending.missing-host-name: PENDING a complete IMPLICIT NONE module with one prior-declared host_item and an ordinary abstract interface or contained procedure importing absent_item, with no other use of absent_item. Replace only that import-name by host_item. The host has no implicit declaration supplying the missing entity, and the control introduces no local homonym.
pending.host-declared-entity-kinds: PENDING finite controls for an ordinary variable, integer named constant, complete derived type and abstract interface, each really declared in the host. The name grammar alone does not establish data/procedure/type identity or resolve generic and namelist domains; those further finite kinds require their actual original owners.
pending.host-use-renamed-name: PENDING a complete provider module exporting original_name and a host with USE provider, ONLY: local_name=>original_name. IMPORT local_name refers to the actual host name. An original_name contrast must first prove it is inaccessible by every other host/use path; IMPORT has no independent rename syntax.
pending.actual-host-identity-source: PENDING a source graph binding each IMPORT occurrence, host scoping unit, accessible entity and declaration/association path, including nested hosts and BLOCK's inclusive-scope distinction. C8105's interface-body prior-declaration condition and C8106's hiding prohibition remain separate; no token-only or undefined-value oracle.

requirements.oracle: Actual host entity/name bindings and otherwise complete one-name repairs, without conflating absence, type compatibility, visibility or prior-declaration conditions.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No arbitrary missing type or provider error counts automatically as C8101. Named constants, variables, types and procedure/interface names are not interchangeable merely because they share a spelling. All source graph and compiler evidence remains pending.

requirements.title: An ONLY import requires every IMPORT in that scope to use ONLY
requirements.definition: If any IMPORT in a scoping unit has ONLY, every IMPORT in that same scoping unit has ONLY. This is independent of source order and is not a last-statement-wins choice. Multiple ONLY lists are permitted subject to all other rules; their accessibility meaning is the p1 union, not a replacement list.

pending.only-and-basic-list: PENDING both source orders of IMPORT, ONLY: first and IMPORT second in a valid contained procedure with both host names. Repair only the latter statement to IMPORT, ONLY: second. No C8104 NONE/ALL antecedent or C8106 shadow is introduced.
pending.only-and-bare-import: PENDING ONLY plus bare IMPORT in the same complete scope, repaired by deleting the bare statement or converting it to a legitimate ONLY list with one chosen minimal pair. Preserve actual host names and ordering.
pending.none-all-overlap-source: PENDING explicit overlap analysis for ONLY mixed with NONE or ALL: C8104 also prohibits another statement. Use one canonical negative family and source-bound relation rather than reporting two independent executions for the same defect.
pending.multiple-only-controls: PENDING two nonempty ONLY lists for distinct host names in one scope, with no other IMPORT form. A complete control must not mistake the rule for exactly-one-IMPORT; actual union semantics keep S8.8-001/-002 ownership.
pending.separate-scope-boundary: PENDING two separate contained procedures or interface bodies with different individually legal import modes. Nested scopes do not merge under3.120, and a BLOCK's independent syntax/presence restrictions remain active.

requirements.oracle: Same-scope mode matrices and exact minimal corrections with no cardinality, host-name or shadowing confounds.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No file-wide token count, presumed sequential overriding, duplicated C8104 credit or fatal-status requirement. Every actual report still needs its live source, valid control and qualified mode.

requirements.title: IMPORT, NONE is excluded from a submodule's own scoping unit
requirements.definition: IMPORT, NONE does not appear in the scoping unit of a submodule. This is not a ban on every IMPORT form or on statements in separately nested procedure scopes. The submodule and its declared ancestor relationship must be legitimate before evaluating the exclusion.

pending.submodule-none-exclusion: PENDING a complete ancestor module declaring a separate module subroutine, and its child submodule providing the matching implementation. Place the sole IMPORT, NONE in the submodule specification part before IMPLICIT/declarations; delete only it for the control. C1412 requires the ancestor's separate-module-procedure declaration; an arbitrary empty parent module is not the control.
pending.submodule-default-control: PENDING the corresponding genuine submodule without IMPORT, NONE, retaining p4 default host access and all matching separate-procedure signatures. A separately qualified ALL or named-list form is not universally prohibited by C8103 but must obey C8104-C8106.
pending.contained-procedure-and-ancestor-source: PENDING exact submodule versus contained module-procedure/interface scoping relations under14.2.3/15.6.2.5/3.120. Any IMPORT, NONE inside a nested eligible procedure needs its own complete interface and local-use conditions; do not attribute it to the submodule's outer scoping unit.

requirements.oracle: A complete buildable ancestor/submodule pair with one deleted statement, not a missing module file or incompatible separate-procedure definition.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No processor-support or module-artifact failure is a successful C8103 report. The rule supplies neither a universal module-scope prohibition nor a runtime host-lifetime effect.

requirements.title: NONE or ALL permits no other IMPORT in its scoping unit
requirements.definition: If a scoping unit contains IMPORT, NONE or IMPORT, ALL, it contains no other IMPORT statement. Repeating the same form still supplies another statement; the rule does not mean only that the two keywords cannot be mixed. Separate scopes and basic/ONLY-only collections keep their own conditions.

pending.repeated-none: PENDING two IMPORT, NONE statements in one ordinary interface body or contained procedure, repaired only by removing one. It is not a submodule and has no ONLY statement, host-name use or local shadowing defect.
pending.repeated-all: PENDING two IMPORT, ALL statements in the same complete eligible scope, repaired by deleting one. No local/USE/formal name hides a host entity; otherwise C8106 would confound the cause.
pending.mixed-none-all: PENDING both source orders of NONE plus ALL, each with a one-statement deletion control. Avoid choosing a submodule for a NONE control or assuming that the later statement overrides the earlier one.
pending.other-form-companions: PENDING NONE/ALL paired with a basic listed or bare IMPORT in otherwise complete scopes. ONLY pairings also invoke C8102 and need one canonical owner plus a separately qualified relation, not duplicate diagnostic credit.
pending.same-scope-and-single-controls: PENDING independently complete single-NONE and single-ALL scopes and distinct nested procedures each with one form. The other IMPORT in another scoping unit is not counted; no general one-IMPORT rule applies to every basic or ONLY form.

requirements.oracle: Complete same-scope statement cardinalities and exact one-deletion controls, preserving actual mode antecedents and scope boundaries.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No token count across a file, implicit default treated as an extra statement, unsupported-mode report or unqualified English/fatal-exit predicate.

requirements.title: Host entities used in an interface body satisfy association or prior-declaration conditions
requirements.definition: An entity accessed by host association within an interface body is accessible by host or use association within that body's host scoping unit, or is explicitly declared before the interface body. The alternatives are not a blanket requirement for a new local declaration immediately before every IMPORT, nor permission to import an otherwise unavailable later host entity.

pending.prior-local-type-control: PENDING a complete module defining a simple type before an ABSTRACT INTERFACE, whose subroutine body imports that type and declares a corresponding dummy. The type and interface names are distinct and complete; no executable body or external-definition linkage is needed for abstract-interface admission.
pending.forward-local-type-source: PENDING the otherwise identical host-local type definition moved after the abstract interface, with the repair consisting solely of moving the full declaration before it. Verify C8101's host identity, type-specification rules and the exact forward-use cause before claiming isolated C8105 diagnosis; an unknown-type recovery alone is insufficient.
pending.host-associated-route: PENDING a complete module type made accessible to a contained module procedure by host association, and then imported by an ordinary interface body inside that procedure. The type is not redeclared locally in the immediate host. Resolve the two genuine association edges and preceding declarations at their actual owners.
pending.use-associated-route: PENDING a complete provider module with a public type or integer constant, USE-associated into the host before an interface body that imports its host-local name. Prior USE is the qualifying alternative, not a copied local declaration; renaming and accessibility must be exact.
pending.interface-kind-and-cause-source: PENDING finite ordinary, abstract and module-procedure interface-body relationships. Default host access differs, but C8105 still applies whenever actual host access occurs. Type/constant-expression eligibility, C8106 hiding and R504 ordering remain independent; no body executes and interface-body declarations that do not affect characteristics are not value-effect evidence.

requirements.oracle: Complete declaration/association graphs and one-order-change source contrasts, with actual interface kind and imported entity identity. No unique cause is assumed before qualifying the whole context.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Host/use association is an explicit alternative to a prior immediate-host declaration. Compiler forward-resolution behavior, missing type/module errors or agreement cannot replace the original condition.

requirements.title: Explicitly imported or ALL-accessible names are not hidden by local contexts
requirements.definition: An entity named in an IMPORT list, or made accessible by IMPORT, ALL, is not placed in a context from19.5.1.4 that would hide the host entity of that name. The imported-name and ALL antecedents matter. Bare IMPORT/default host access instead retains p4's ordinary hiding exception; identifiers and entity roles are not interchangeable.

pending.basic-listed-name-shadow: PENDING a complete host with INTEGER x and an internal or module subroutine containing IMPORT x followed by INTEGER x. Delete only the inner type declaration for a no-read control, so it refers to the prior host object. Place IMPORT before IMPLICIT NONE/declarations and retain source-specific duplicate/host-hiding overlap analysis.
pending.only-listed-name-shadow: PENDING the same genuine host/local contrast with IMPORT, ONLY: x. The repaired scope has no other IMPORT form; C8102 is not the selected violation.
pending.all-name-shadow: PENDING IMPORT, ALL followed by a local declaration hiding host x, repaired only by removing that declaration. Ensure other formal/procedure/USE names do not introduce additional imported-host conflicts.
pending.dummy-result-and-use-contexts: PENDING complete contexts for a dummy/result name or an independent USE-associated local name that would hide an explicitly imported host entity under19.5.1.4p2. Signature/interface and provider changes must be adjudicated before selecting a genuinely minimal role-valid repair; no invalid missing actual or missing module is the control.
pending.complete-local-identifier-source: PENDING a finite denominator over the actual19.5.1.4p2 contexts, including specification statements, DATA/EQUIVALENCE, procedure/construct/type and naming routes and their exceptions. Importing one variable and checking one type declaration does not close every route. Do not apply object-name rules to a different procedure or COMMON branch solely by text.
pending.bare-unlisted-shadow-controls: PENDING an otherwise conforming scope with bare IMPORT and a new local x, or an ONLY list that does not name x, where actual p1/p4 and type-mapping conditions permit local x. A different local identifier is not universally forbidden merely because a host homonym exists. Exact source relationships to the violating named/ALL cases are required.

requirements.oracle: Actual imported entity bindings and precisely identified hiding contexts with complete minimal controls. Full source/name graphs, not declaration keywords, determine the predicate.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Do not universalize ALL's no-hiding condition to bare IMPORT/default scope, or interpret a genuine different-entity declaration as mutation of the host object. Reporting needs a live source and valid context; no new runtime or canonical-link evidence is supplied.

requirements.title: ONLY restricts non-BLOCK host association to names listed in that scope
requirements.definition: Outside BLOCK, if IMPORT with ONLY appears, host association requires the entity's name to occur in an IMPORT list in that scoping unit. Names from multiple conforming ONLY lists are considered together. This restricts host association, not separately valid local declarations, USE association or intrinsic type availability.

pending.listed-name-union: PENDING a complete ordinary interface body with two ONLY statements importing two prior host integer constants used separately in dummy bounds, or an internal procedure with independently observed host constants. C8102 requires every IMPORT to be ONLY; p1 does not replace the first list with the second.
pending.unlisted-host-name-exclusion: PENDING a complete host-derived-type use omitted from an ONLY list and repaired by adding only that actual host name. Resolve numbered type/name constraints or4.2p2(6)'s actual Clause19 basis before diagnostic metadata; the prose itself does not prescribe fatal rejection.
pending.independent-use-and-local-routes: PENDING a separate USE provider or explicitly declared local entity whose identifier is not imported from the host. ONLY does not ban those independent routes. Avoid C8106 by not making that identifier an import-name, and bind the correct entity instead of reading an undefined implicit local.
pending.nested-host-paths: PENDING complete ancestor/intermediate/importing-scope graphs, including a type or constant already host/use associated in the immediate host. The actual local name at each edge matters; a globally existing entity is not automatically an imported host entity.
pending.intrinsic-and-mapping-boundaries: PENDING separate canonical relationships for intrinsic type keywords, intrinsic procedure-name resolution and8.7 implicit mappings. IMPORT, ONLY is not IMPLICIT NONE, a reset of host implicit mappings or permission to reference an undefined newly local variable.

requirements.oracle: Finite source/use/interface graphs with named host identities, nonhost-route controls and individually justified observables where a real effect program is appropriate.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No implemented graph or fixture is supplied. A declaration-only empty run, type keyword acceptance or aggregate count cannot prove the complete host-access restriction. Exact reporting ownership and named-constant/bound prerequisites remain required.

requirements.title: BLOCK ONLY lists make unlisted enclosing local and construct identifiers inaccessible
requirements.definition: When BLOCK contains ONLY imports, identifiers of local and construct entities in its host scoping unit are inaccessible there unless they appear in at least one of its import-name lists. This is the union of all lists and uses BLOCK's identifier/inclusive-scope rules, not a blanket internal-procedure host-association model.

pending.block-list-union: PENDING a complete program with distinct enclosing defined integer entities and a BLOCK containing two ONLY lists. Bind every permitted/unlisted identifier to its actual enclosing declaration. An unlisted independent BLOCK local is not the same entity and must be declared explicitly.
pending.implicit-enclosing-entity-boundary: PENDING original note4's complete default-mapping program with IMPORT, ONLY selecting some other existing name while the assigned X remains unlisted, repaired by adding X. An implicitly declared name used only in BLOCK can belong to the enclosing inclusive scope; do not treat an assignment alone as a new BLOCK local.
pending.separate-local-construct-control: PENDING IMPORT, ONLY: kept in a BLOCK that explicitly declares a distinct local object, versus an enclosing homonym not in the list. Resolve19.4p3 and C8106 before a value program; IMPORT itself does not declare a construct entity.
pending.nested-construct-identity-source: PENDING nested BLOCK/enclosing construct-entity cases with exact19.1/19.4 scope boundaries and one-list-union accounting. Global identifiers, USE-created construct entities and ASYNCHRONOUS/VOLATILE exceptions require their actual categories, not an all-names filter.

requirements.oracle: Source-bound finite BLOCK identifier inventories and role-valid controls, with separately justified scope-diagnostic or real-value evidence.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No hidden host-association substitute, implicit-new-local assumption, undefined payload inquiry or no-op runtime classifier. IMPLICIT statements are not inserted into R1109's BLOCK specification grammar.

requirements.title: NONE disables host association and is the ordinary interface-body default
requirements.source: 8.8 p2 first and second sentences, physical PDF144.
requirements.definition: IMPORT, NONE makes host entities unavailable by host association in its scoping unit. An interface body other than a module procedure interface body has this behavior by default. This neither prohibits independent USE/local entities nor gives all interface bodies the same host default. BLOCK has the separately specified identifier rule.

pending.explicit-none-host-exclusion: PENDING a complete internal procedure with IMPORT, NONE and a use requiring a real host type, repaired by replacing NONE with an appropriate valid named or ALL import. No submodule NONE, mixed IMPORT or invalid declaration order is part of the initial contrast. Adjudicate the actual type/scope reporting owner.
pending.ordinary-interface-default: PENDING ordinary and abstract interface bodies with no IMPORT, a complete host type and a dummy needing that type, repaired by inserting IMPORT type_name. No ordinary interface body is treated as executing, and a missing external definition is not the failure being tested.
pending.independent-use-and-local-control: PENDING the same NONE scope with a genuine explicit local declaration or its own USE association supplying the required name. Prove the distinct declaration/path and no host-name import; NONE is not a ban on all entities or intrinsic type keywords.
pending.implicit-mapping-is-separate: PENDING original8.7 mapping relationships: an ordinary interface body has its own default unless IMPLICIT specifies otherwise, while internal procedures and BLOCK inherit their applicable host mapping. IMPORT, NONE does not mean IMPLICIT NONE or reset a previously inherited null mapping. Define every runtime value before observing it.
pending.module-interface-default-boundary: PENDING actual module procedure interface bodies with the MODULE prefix and C8105-compliant prior host declarations. Their default is p4 host access, not ordinary-interface NONE. A generic interface containing MODULE PROCEDURE names is not itself a module procedure interface body.

requirements.oracle: Exact interface/scope kinds and independent name-path controls, with missing-host semantics separated from implicit typing and actual procedure implementation.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No universal interface-body rule, external/link failure, copying mechanism or compulsory runtime trap. The ordinary-interface default is a semantic rule even without an IMPORT token; it needs a finite qualified witness, not a keyword census.

requirements.title: BLOCK NONE makes enclosing local and construct identifiers inaccessible
requirements.definition: IMPORT, NONE in BLOCK makes identifiers of local and construct entities in the host scoping unit inaccessible in that BLOCK. It does not create new local variables for otherwise implicitly declared names, nor prohibit a genuinely separate explicitly declared BLOCK entity. Identifier categories and inclusive scope remain operative.

pending.implicit-outer-name-exclusion: PENDING the complete original note4 program with X used only in BLOCK and the default main-program mapping. The assignment implicitly declares X in the main scoping unit, so NONE makes it inaccessible. The original IMPORT, ONLY: X repair is a source-qualified candidate; it does not require an invented earlier explicit declaration of X.
pending.explicit-block-local-control: PENDING a distinct control inserting a real type declaration for X inside a NONE BLOCK, making X a construct entity there. Do not conflate this local-entity repair with restoring access to the enclosing X. Any value witness must separately initialize and check the actual entities.
pending.enclosing-construct-entity-source: PENDING a complete nested BLOCK whose outer BLOCK explicitly declares an object; the inner NONE scope must respect that construct identifier's scope. The outer name is not transformed into a local inner variable by an assignment.
pending.identifier-category-boundary: PENDING exact19.1/19.3/19.4 category inventory, including genuine own USE/local entities and nonlocal identifier alternatives. The source specifically names local and construct entities; do not rewrite it as deletion of every global or intrinsic identifier.

requirements.oracle: Finite inclusive-scope/construct-entity graphs and complete note-derived contrasts, not a fabricated host-value runtime classification.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No undefined read or IMPLICIT statement in BLOCK, no blanket ban on new explicit locals, and no automatic mandatory diagnosis from prose alone. Actual numbered/name-scope or policy bases precede negative metadata.

requirements.title: ALL makes every host entity accessible subject to the no-hiding constraints
requirements.definition: IMPORT, ALL makes all entities from the host scoping unit accessible in the importing scoping unit. Actual host identity and C8104-C8106 still apply. It is stronger than ordinary default host access with respect to hiding, not a new copy of every host object or an extension of the host instance's lifetime.

pending.actual-host-value-observation: PENDING a complete program with a defined host INTEGER value3, one actual internal procedure beginning with IMPORT, ALL, and a direct update of that same host object to7. Independent caller/callee literal3/7 checks, entry/return/check/completion counts and whole-program wrong-oracle/omission sensitivity are required. No copied dummy or uninitialized subject supplies the effect.
pending.host-type-and-interface-source: PENDING finite actual complete host type, named constant, abstract-interface and procedure-identifier paths, with interfaces and C8105 prior-availability conditions. A source/interface evidence mechanism is needed; a declaration-only empty run is not an effect witness.
pending.no-hiding-relation: PENDING a source relationship to C8106's named/ALL conflicts, using actual shared complete inputs with their existing roles. Bare IMPORT's allowed local hiding must not be copied to ALL; no duplicate negative or automatic numbered-target link.
pending.finite-all-scope-inventory: PENDING a declared finite source denominator for eligible internal/module/interface/submodule/BLOCK contexts and host entity classes. Derived-type default access is not permission for an ALL statement inside its grammar. Scope accessibility grants no alias, SAVE, privacy, initialization, memory-layout or lifetime relaxation.

requirements.oracle: Actual host-entity observations where executable, and finite source/interface mappings otherwise, with independently established identities and values.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No fixtures are implemented. One scalar update cannot prove every host entity/category or scope. ALL does not promise physical copying, access to an unrelated module or use of an ended host instance.

requirements.title: Bare IMPORT and designated default scopes provide host access with normal hiding exceptions
requirements.definition: Bare IMPORT, with neither a specifier nor a name list, gives access to host entities except where19.5.1.4 makes a host name inaccessible. This is the default for a derived-type definition, internal subprogram, module procedure interface body, module subprogram or submodule. The list of default scopes does not insert IMPORT into otherwise ineligible grammar; bare/default behavior is not ALL's no-hiding rule.

pending.bare-host-value-observation: PENDING a complete live host/internal-procedure program with bare IMPORT, direct access to a defined host INTEGER3 and an independently checked update7, with entry/return/check/completion and whole-parent sensitivity. The statement is nonexecutable; the observer tests the resolved entity, not execution of IMPORT.
pending.default-internal-module-scopes: PENDING complete internal and module procedures with no IMPORT and real host constant/object observations, retaining identical source/mapping/interface premises. Default access is tested by actual name resolution, not absence of a token alone.
pending.legitimate-local-shadow: PENDING a bare-IMPORT or no-IMPORT internal scope explicitly declaring its own INTEGER x while the host has a different defined x. Independently observe local7 and unchanged host3 with meaningful counted completion. The local declaration is allowed under p4; the corresponding ALL/named context would invoke C8106. No default-initialized value or dummy alias is assumed.
pending.module-interface-default: PENDING a true MODULE-prefixed procedure interface body using a prior-declared host type without IMPORT, with complete matching interface/implementation where used. The ordinary interface-body default is NONE; a MODULE PROCEDURE statement in a generic interface is not the same construct.
pending.derived-type-default-source: PENDING a complete type definition whose component declaration uses an accessible prior host kind/length constant under genuine specification-expression rules. R726 has no IMPORT slot: test the default through actual dependent declaration identity rather than adding bare IMPORT inside the type. Component names and type parameters have distinct identifier classes and their shadowing conditions must be source-qualified.
pending.submodule-default-source: PENDING complete C1412-valid ancestor/submodule contexts with actual inherited names and matching separate procedures. A missing ancestor module file or NONE exclusion is not a test of default access; host-private accessibility and independent USE paths retain their original rules.
pending.all-versus-bare-source: PENDING explicit relationships among default/bare, named/ONLY and ALL routes. All scopes and actual19.5.1.4 hiding contexts need a finite source inventory; no blanket host-import graph or existing type-access case is automatically adopted.

requirements.oracle: Real name-resolution/value observations and independently bound source/interface/declaration graphs, preserving defaults and ordinary shadowing exceptions.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No cases are implemented. IMPORT is not executable copying, no-op output is not host access, and a finite scalar witness is not universal coverage of every default scope or name class.

requirements.title: Listed IMPORT makes each named host entity accessible outside BLOCK
requirements.definition: Outside BLOCK, an IMPORT with an import-name list makes each named host entity accessible. This positive availability rule is not itself the ONLY exclusion rule and does not erase C8101, C8105 or C8106. Ordinary interface bodies, other host defaults and BLOCK-specific identifier rules retain their distinct conditions.

pending.ordinary-interface-type-availability: PENDING a complete module-defined simple type and an ordinary/abstract interface body importing that prior type for a real dummy declaration. Bind the imported type to the host definition, not a fresh same-spelled type. Compile admission is a finite interface control; an effect claim needs a real qualifying call/value observation or implemented source/interface mechanism.
pending.multiple-basic-lists: PENDING one complete ordinary interface body with IMPORT first and IMPORT second naming distinct prior host constants/types.
